rules.documents: All authored docs/**/*.md, including nested documentation and infographic-prompts.md
rules.agentInstructions: Agent/skill instruction directories and conventional instruction filenames excluded
rules.unknownFiles: Reported, never copied; executable and active-content formats are not allowed
rules.symlinks: Skipped and reported; source/destination root symlinks are rejected
rules.credentials: Selected text scanned for high-confidence credentials before destination changes
rules.ownership: Only prior manifest-owned stale files removed; modified files require --force
rules.license: LICENSE preserved in snapshot and destination project root
